title: Article 19 — Freedoms of speech, assembly, movement and profession

content.overview: Article 19(1) of the Constitution of India guarantees specified freedoms to citizens. Clauses (2) to (6) permit only reasonable restrictions on the grounds enacted in those clauses.
content.study: Identify the freedom first: speech, assembly, association, movement, residence, or profession. Then identify the restriction and the clause that is said to authorise it. Reasonableness is not a free-floating slogan. After Maneka, Articles 14, 19 and 21 are read together when a restriction also deprives life or liberty. Article 19 rights are citizen rights.
